description: Converting a map to an object type drops a key that sorts before the object's attributes
notes: The spec makes it an error to convert a map whose set of keys doesn't exactly match the object type's attributes (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions). hashicorp/hcl's convert converts with go-cty's convert.Convert, whose map to object conversion skips each map key that isn't an attribute of the object type (conversionMapToObject in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), so a is dropped and b is kept.
